About the center

Trusted diagnostics, close to home

Jain Diagnostic Centre, led by Dr. Ashish Jain, MBBS, MD (Radiodiagnosis) — formerly of Safdarjung Hospital — has been Puth Khurd's trusted name in pathology, imaging, and preventive health testing since 2010. Our NABH-accredited lab combines modern equipment with a team of experienced radiologists and technicians who believe good diagnosis starts with genuine care.

From routine blood work to diagnostic imaging and specialised endocrinology, cardiac, and pulmonary testing, we're built for accuracy and clarity — with online results available for those who'd rather not wait around for a printout.

  • NABH & ISO accredited laboratory
  • Experienced pathologists & radiologists on site
  • Care personally guided by Dr. Ashish Jain
  • Digital reports on WhatsApp & email
Meet the doctor

Dr. Ashish Jain

Dr. Jain founded Jain Diagnostic Centre in 2010 after his tenure at Safdarjung Hospital, one of Delhi's leading government hospitals, with a simple goal: bring reliable, hospital-grade diagnostics to Puth Khurd without the long drive across the city.

Today he personally oversees every ultrasound, X-ray, and radiology report that leaves the centre — reading each one with the same care he brought to his hospital practice.

MBBS MD · Radiodiagnosis Ex. Safdarjung Hospital Since 2010

Our promise

Why patients keep coming back to us

Good diagnosis takes more than machines — it takes people who care about getting it right, the first time.

01

Guided by real expertise

Every report is personally overseen by Dr. Ashish Jain, so results are read with clinical judgement, not just machines.

02

Reports you can trust

Modern equipment, careful sample handling, and double-checked results — because a wrong report can cost more than time.

03

Every step explained clearly

Our team walks you through each test and result in plain language — no confusing jargon left unexplained.

04

One centre, every test you need

From routine blood work to imaging and cardiac screening — no running between different labs across the city.

05

Honest, upfront pricing

No hidden charges or surprise add-ons — ask for a quote on WhatsApp before you book anything.

06

A calmer visit

A clean, unhurried facility and a staff trained to explain every step, not just perform it.
